hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "=== INSERT ==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert flags

tool_input.command:
hops fg create customersde746e --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" \
  --description "Customers initial export (v1)" 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customersde746e --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -20

hops fg create customersde746e --version 2 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance currency varies,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" \
  --description "Customers full reload (v2, new schema)" 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg insert customersde746e --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -15

echo "=== V2 INFO ==="; hops fg info customersde746e --version 2 2>&1 | grep -E '^\{'; echo "=== V2 PREVIEW ==="; hops fg preview customersde746e --version 2 --n 5 2>&1 | grep -E '^\{|^\['; echo "=== V2 STATS ==="; hops fg stats customersde746e --version 2 2>&1 | grep -E '^\{|count'
